teacher_info.about_teacher:
What can I do for you?
Well, I can practice English conversation with you. We can talk about whatever topics that interest you.

We can talk about serious or causal topics.

For example, I have been working for various companies and online businesses in the past few years so we can practice English in a business setting.

But we can also talk about casual topics like travel, cultural differences, etc. I notice a lot of people here are digital nomads and travelers so the good news is that I have a lot of stories relating to these topics. We can share these stories together.

Let's hit our language goals together.
teacher_info.teaching_style: I should mention that this is mainly just free talking and conversation practice. I am not yet an expert in all the rules of English grammar. But I can type out corrections on what you said during the class so you have some notes to review.

teacher_info.intro:
Hello! 
I’m an American Linguistics student who loves learning and teaching languages! 
I have studied French, Spanish, Chinese, and Arabic, so I understand the challenges of learning a new language. I have lived in LA, Switzerland, Paris, and Mexico. I've traveled to different European countries and love connecting with people from diverse cultures. I believe that when we travel and learn about new cultures, we become more well-rounded people. 
As a teacher, I bring the same curiosity and adaptability I have as a learner, experimenting with methods and resources to find what works best for each student, just as I do in my own language study.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
I have been living in Paris for over three years now. I taught English to French children in middle and high school, and French to newly arrived refugees. 
I am pursuing a master's in Linguistics and Computer Science here in Paris. 
I have also taught kindergarten in Los Angeles and tutored students throughout high school. I have a TESOL certification and have been on Italki for about five years. 
I am very patient and will encourage you to speak, I find that it is the best way to learn. You can learn anything you want with practice and I hope you will consider me to help you reach your language goals; we'll laugh and learn together!
teacher_info.teaching_style:
I've used Italki to practice Spanish and Chinese and found that informal conversation has helped me the most! I know that it can be scary, especially the first lesson, but it gets easier! 
In conversation lessons, we can talk about topics like travel, films, and music. We can have debates, practice job interviews, slang, or anything you are interested in! 
I can be a casual speaking partner with a low-pressure, non-judgmental, and informal nature or, if you prefer, we can have more structured and prepared lessons focused on improving your weaknesses in English or French. Whether you prefer relaxed chats or targeted learning, I’m here to help you grow in a way that suits you best!

course_info.trial_description: This trial is a quick introduction to help me to understand your language level and for you to see if we are a good match.

pro_course_detail.title: 🗣 Conversation Practice With Corrections (All levels)
pro_course_detail.description: Informal conversation practice to become more comfortable speaking English. For students with a conversational level of English. We can chat about a wide range of topics from subjects that I can choose or that you can decide on for yourself (just let me know before the lesson). I will help correct your mistakes and make suggestions. These are natural conversations usually. I may suggest an article or a video to watch before or during the lesson. I could also ask you questions to begin speaking about a specific topic or play a game. I take notes while you speak and will provide corrections near the end of the lesson.

teacher_info.about_teacher: As a teacher I am very encouraging, upbeat, and patient.  I believe it's important to expose yourself new topics of conversation to build vocabulary.  It's also important to consume Native Content that pertains to one's interest, whether it be videos, podcast, books, or articles.  I like to spark conversations with questions that give students a chance to practice. At the same time,  I am very careful to not talk to much and dominate the conversation.  I don't believe in making corrections that inhibit the flow of conversation, but do take notes and share feedback at the end of each lesson.

I will take notes that I will share with students at the end of each lesson.  If my student wants more I may even give homework that we can go over the next class.

I have experience in a wide range of methodologies, and work with my students to find the particular combination of approaches that works best for them. I can assure, and guarantee you what approaches work effectively for your learning. Based on this experience, I design my courses to give you the most interactive, and diversified learning, focusing on all grammatical points needed for you to advance to any level you desire. As a language student, you will have an organized, coherent, and functionally complete sequence of lessons, no matter what your language level may be. Even though I usually speak only in the language being taught in class, I can use one of the other languages I know (French, English, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, and Greek) to help you understand with accuracy. On your first lesson, you will be evaluated and informed on your level, and choose the appropriate materials to use based on your goals. We will then formulate a learning plan that contains a specific set of activities that we will perform in the upcoming lessons to address your immediate needs, based on a priority depending on your level. My teaching style varies based on how the student learns best. Visual learners are individuals who prefer to take in their information visually—be that with maps, graphs, diagrams, charts, and others.
Auditory learners are individuals who learn better when they take in information in auditory form when it is heard or spoken. Kinesthetic learners are individuals who prefer to learn by doing. Reading/writing learners consume information best when it’s in words, whether that’s by writing it down or reading it. My goals are to make sure the students feel comfortable, valued, & inspired. I want them to feel excited to come to class, learn something new, and speak English with confidence and ease.

pro_course_detail.title: English Class for Beginners: BASIC QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS
pro_course_detail.description:
Hello language learners :) Welcome to my class! Let's start with the basics...

PART 1 - Teacher Asks the Questions
1.   Greetings
2.   How are you?
3.   What is your name?
4    Where do you live?
5.   What subjects are you studying?
6.   Where do you work?
7.   What are your favorite hobbies?
8.   What do you do for fun?
9.   Finishing Statement
10. Farewell 

Part 2 - Student Asks the Questions


There are several ways to answer these questions and together we will break down the options. 

After you are comfortable answering AND asking these questions we will practice conversation time including these questions and answers.

These questions and answers are the necessary pleasantries commonly used when first meeting someone and is essential in building communication, connections, and relationships.

pro_course_detail.title: LESSONS: 1) CONVERSATION CLASS  2) THE INTERVIEW THAT WILL GET YOU HIRED & 3) PUBLIC SPEAKING WITH CONFIDENCE
pro_course_detail.description:
Hello, Language Learners of the World :)  Welcome!

Session 1
MASTER YOUR CONVERSATION SKILLS
If you want to speak English FLUENTLY this is the class for YOU! 

Session 2
THE ART OF THE INTERVIEW
Learn how to interview and get the job. Being interviewed can often be very stressful but I have been interviewed hundreds of times, in front of large audiences, on TV shows, and also 1 on 1. Master the skill set needed to give the best interview & win that position. With this skill set, you will walk into your interview ready to be hired on the spot!  Learn how to prepare for the interview, manage anxiety, and valuable details such as body language, poise, dress code & much more. We will also practice 1 on 1.

Session 3
SPEAK WITH CONFIDENCE
Are you terrified of speaking in front of a group of people? Maybe for school presentations, monthly work meetings, or singing in a group or acting in a play? 
Mastering public speaking will increase your confidence in all parts of your life, including your conversations, interactions, &  job interviews. Step into your power, kiss your fears away, & start speaking with confidence & passion.

ABOUT ME
Public Speaking is my specialty & helping people achieve their goals is my passion.
 I'm a scholarship graduate of the American Academy of Dramatic Arts & graduated in the same class as Paul Rudd.

I created, produced & hosted a TV show that was on the WB for 2 seasons & had top ratings, only second to Jimmy Kimmel. My partner & I choreographed a performance pitch which we showcased for one year. Performing under pressure is a very valuable skill, as is reducing stress & anxiety.  I have mastered these skills & can teach you how to apply them in all areas of your life.

Having won many titles such as Miss Teen Vancouver, Miss World Canada Finalist, Professional Cheerleader for the CFL, working in the modeling, dancing, acting industry from a young age, being on stage just comes naturally.

LET'S GET YOU SPEAKING WITH PASSION & CONFIDENCE!

pro_course_detail.title: LIFE COACHING WITH ME
pro_course_detail.description:
The Definition of a Life Coach
An advisor who helps people make decisions, set and reach goals, deal with problems, and overcome challenges.

*NOTE - 60 Minute Sessions are the best choice for the student.

My process is based on the individual and where they are at in their journey. The first session is based on gathering information and listening to my clients' challenges, wants, and needs. Other factors I take into account are their mental/emotional state, thought process, and physical condition. Once assessed, we mutually discuss a plan that works for both of us and then we start the work. My goal is to offer strategies and implement practices that will make everyday purpose-driven, fulfilling, and triumphant. Positivity is a key factor in conquering any challenge and I can attest from experience that how you approach problems is paramount in how to resolve issues and ultimately achieve success.

I provide a safe, confidential, and comfortable space that allows one to feel free to say whatever is on their mind, discuss issues however personal and confront what is holding them back from living a life full of joy, meaning, and abundance. There is no judgment, only support, compassion, and empathy.

PEOPLE ARE MY PASSION
My goal is to share information, inspiration, insight and ultimately change lives so that each and every person I work with can learn how to live their best.... most fulfilling life.

THIS IS MY CALLING. THIS IS MY PURPOSE. THIS IS MY GIFT.

HELLO! 
My name is Allyson Lovina :)
I am your SPEAKER I am your TEACHER I am your COACH

pro_course_detail.title: Fun English Conversation - Free Talk or Topic of The Day - Kids & Adults :)
pro_course_detail.description: Each day will be something new - a new topic or multiple different topics. We will have conversations, ask questions, and engage in some fun activities and/or games. You will gain an understanding of the topic(s) as well as how to use it in a sentence and how to ask questions around that topic(s). Also, I will provide written feedback on other alternatives or suggestions. Have fun while learning!

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Plus + Kids & Adults
pro_course_detail.description: Let's have some fun! We will focus on an article, a section of a book, a podcast, or other language material and we will discuss the content together. This class will focus on expanding vocabulary, pronunciation, and improving basic conversation skills on many different topics. Also, I will provide written feedback and homework (if you'd like)!

pro_course_detail.title: Book Club! Kids & Adults
pro_course_detail.description: Do you love to read? Are you trying to improve your English? Reading is a great way to learn! You can choose a book that you would like to read (or I can pick one for you) and we can read parts together and discuss what we've learned. This class will help to improve reading, speaking, listening, and pronunciation skills. Have fun while learning!
